cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Glycerin, glycol distearate, shea butter, hyaluronate and cationic polymers buffer feel, so confidence stays moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: early glycerin, glycol distearate, shea butter, sodium hyaluronate and two cationic polymer routes form a broad curl/moisture care system.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The formula is silicone-free and strong-cleansing, so the high-care call remains moderate-confidence.

weightPotential.counterSignal: Olefin sulfonate and sarcosinate provide strong reset capacity, and no silicone ingredient is present.
